description.en: DuoBench is a benchmarking framework for bimanual manipulation policies on the FR3 Duo platform, with eleven tasks across four coordination categories, simulated and partially real-world, plus human-teleoperated datasets. It proposes stage-based evaluation beyond binary success.

evidence.snippet: We introduce DuoBench, an extensible benchmarking framework for bimanual manipulation policies on the FR3 Duo platform.

claire_radar.motivation: Bimanual robot systems substantially expand manipulation capabilities, but coordinating two arms introduces additional control complexity and failure modes that are not well captured by existing benchmarks.
